el.Música que salió del monte, con grillos: Music that came out of the wild, with real crickets and a mother wolf.
el.Una madre loba nos alimentó hasta los 20: A mother wolf fed us until we were 20. In 1998 we went out into the world for the first time, and in 2008 we vanished for good. What's left is in the playlist.
el.Gente real metida en el monte, grabando: Real people deep in the wild, recording real crickets: leaves, cigarette butts, flowers, night flight. Listen to it, and who knows, it might just change your life.
